paragraphs: Rav Shmuel the Cappadocian: Ha-Shohet, 27b. Kappodokya: Jerusalem Yoma, end of Shenei Se'irim, and Pesahim, Ellu Devarim, halakhah 7. R' Avin reports in R' Shmuel Kappodokya's name: Midrash Kohelet, at “All this I tested through wisdom.” R' Yonah reports in his name: Hallah, beginning of chapter 3. And R' Haggai.
